title: confiture migrate apply-as --format json
description: The one migration `migrate apply-as <role> <version>` applied, connected with the URL under `apply_as.<role>.url`. A missing URL, an unknown or already-applied version, or a failed migration writes the error envelope (error-envelope.schema.json) instead.

success.description: Always true in this shape: a failure writes the error envelope.

applied_by.description: The role argument, as given; also recorded in the ledger row's `applied_by`.

ok.description: The envelope (1.16.0): the command produced this report. A command that could not produce one writes the error envelope, where ok is false.

command.description: The envelope (1.16.0): the command that wrote this payload, as typed after `confiture`.
